rules.title: Query by id without ownership filter (heuristic)
rules.message: Object loaded by id alone is a common IDOR root cause. Confirm the query also scopes to the current principal/tenant.
rules.fix: Add user_id/tenant_id (or equivalent) to the authorization check on every object access.

rules.title: JWT algorithm set to none
rules.message: Accepting alg=none lets attackers forge tokens without a signature.
rules.fix: Pin allowed algorithms to a signed set (e.g. HS256/RS256) and reject none.

rules.title: CSRF protection disabled
rules.message: CSRF defenses turned off. Confirm this is intentional and limited to non-cookie auth surfaces.
rules.fix: Re-enable CSRF for cookie-session browsers; use SameSite and anti-forgery tokens.
